author: Kalvin64674
quote:
When me and my Dad looked through this game and its details and fun elements, we had a good time!
But overtime this game slowly became just GTA 5 mixed with Red Dead Redemption 2, which ISN’T terrible…
But the game has been dumbed down a lot, the graphics are beautiful, but the game has a ton of bugs (as of writing this) the pacing is way too slow in some parts, and the ending didn’t really make us feel anything.
Overall, I’m very disappointed on how this game turned out, I’m not going to pretend to say I liked it, because this might genuinely be one of those biggest disappointments I’ve seen in a while.

author: Kalvin64674
quote:
HI, So I have a few things to say about this game “series”
First off…I’ll give some positive feedback.
This game has nice graphics at some parts, and the music sounds fine…but that’s it.
Now the reason why I’m giving this a straight up 0 is because of a LOT of reasons.
For one, this game lasts for only about a few minutes.
Compared to other rpgs that last longer.
Like sure, The combat is infinite in a way.
But it’s not fun when you’re stuck in the same area over and over again.
The combat is weird too, You aim your weapon and throw it to attack…It’s strange but I guess it’s unique.
The characters themselves have some kind of personality…but it’s not nearly enough to peak someone’s interest.
Because the game doesn’t even last that long.
The overworld is also very short…and very restrictive if you have an objective.
For example, when you have to get the stone in Part two, you can’t enter the forest.
You are LIMITED to one or two areas.
I also don’t understand why these games cost 0.99 either.
Like I could play a game on gamejolt that has way better stuff than this and is also made by ONE person.
And yet it cost no money.
I do like the Christianity, But if your here for just RPG standards and want basic but unique gameplay….I don’t think you’ll like this game.
If you can find a single person who appreciates this game till the end…I’ll be suprised.
game_title: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter (Part One)
